title: MaleCNS v1.0 auditory pathway subset

queries: MATCH (n:Neuron) WHERE (n.type STARTS WITH "JO-A" OR n.type STARTS WITH "JO-B") AND NOT n.type CONTAINS "unclear" RETURN properties(n) AS p

MATCH (s:Neuron)-[c:ConnectsTo]->(n:Neuron) WHERE s.bodyId IN [35351, 934247, 29561, 427762, 512975, 469098413, 367193015, 519875, 932780, 274169, 381870, 559386, 536998, 149854, 535965, 112105, 241016, 144112, 114598, 974267957] AND (n.type CONTAINS "aPN1" OR n.instance CONTAINS "aPN1") RETURN s.bodyId AS source,s.type AS sourceType,n.bodyId AS target,n.type AS targetType,c.weight AS weight ORDER BY weight DESC
MATCH (m:Meta) RETURN m.voxelSize AS voxelSize,m.voxelUnits AS voxelUnits,m.uuid AS uuid,m.lastDatabaseEdit AS lastDatabaseEdit LIMIT 1
provenance.selection: For every JO-A and JO-B type excluding types containing unclear, select the neuron with highest pre count per recorded root side (tie: post descending, bodyId ascending); select the 20 highest aggregate direct downstream partners of these 20 seeds by ConnectsTo.weight, excluding seeds. Include every observed ConnectsTo edge whose two endpoints are selected.
provenance.skeletonEncoding: [SWC point id, x, y, z, SWC parent point id]. All coordinates and parent links retained from source; no extra simplification applied. SWC type and radius columns omitted from compact geometry; original SWCs preserved alongside acquisition script.
provenance.skeletonSourceNote: Public NeuTu-generated SWCs contain per-neuron sampling and resolution headers, retained in each node skeletonSource.headers. Sampling settings and downresLevel vary between neurons. All source coordinates and parent links are retained; no additional geometric simplification was applied. Skeletons represent segmented neurites, not cell surfaces.
provenance.neurotransmitter: Per-neuron predictedNt and predictedNtConfidence; predictions are not direct transmitter measurements.

limitations: A deliberately small selected anatomical subnetwork, not a complete auditory connectome or whole-brain model.
Neuron type-and-side representatives are selected by pre count; available reconstructions and synapse counts are asymmetric between sides.
Edges are directed observed structural connections; weight does not establish physiological strength, sign, activation, or causality.
This subset contains no measured activity, membrane dynamics, audio response, or electrophysiological simulation.
No edges from selected seeds to target type or instance containing aPN1 were returned by the explicit query.
Coordinates use the source MaleCNS frame and have not been warped, registered, centered, or scaled.
